## 🧪 Validation performed

Commands and actual results:

## 🔌 API and data impact

Describe endpoint, payload, response, schema, or migration changes. Write “None” when not applicable.

## 🔐 Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, database URLs, tokens, or private data added.
- [ ] Input validation and authorization implications reviewed.
- [ ] Error messages do not expose internal details.

## 📚 Documentation

- [ ] README and relevant docs updated.
- [ ] Mermaid diagrams and internal links checked.
- [ ] Roadmap/changelog updated where appropriate.

## ✅ Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused.
- [ ] Existing behavior is preserved or intentional changes are explained.
- [ ] No generated dependency folders or build artifacts were added.
